# <Feature> cross-application requirements

## Background and goal

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it cannot be separated into app-local requirements.

## Common contracts and boundaries

Record only indivisible requirements, data/protocol contracts, and dependency direction.
Do not copy each application's implementation here.

## Owning documents

Link the application feature directories and any repository infrastructure feature.
Application details belong in `apps/<app>/docs/spec/<date>-<feature>/`;
repository infrastructure belongs in `docs/spec/<date>-<feature>/`.

## Dependencies and acceptance

Name sequencing requirements, observable acceptance checks, and excluded behavior.

## Risks

State data/compatibility risks and rollback boundaries. The first Git date fixes the filename.
